Camper van road trips across India

  • Ladakh — High passes, turquoise lakes and monasteries on the roof of the world (best June – September)
  • Spiti Valley — A cold desert of cliff-top monasteries and fossil villages (best May – October)
  • Goa — Palm-fringed beaches, Portuguese lanes and sunset shacks (best November – March)
  • Kerala — Backwaters, tea hills and misty spice country (best September – March)
  • Rajasthan — Forts, palaces and golden desert nights (best October – March)
  • Manali & Kullu — Pine forests, rivers and snowy passes within easy reach (best March – June, October)
  • Rishikesh & Garhwal — Ganga river camps, yoga and Himalayan foothills (best September – November, February – May)
  • Coorg & Chikmagalur — Coffee estates, waterfalls and rainforest roads (best October – April)
  • Meghalaya — Living root bridges, crystal rivers and the cloud kingdom (best October – April)
